items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Gochugaru (seasoning)' to USDA SR Legacy 'Spices, pepper, red or cayenne' through a retained exact evidence record. Gochugaru is dried Korean red chili pepper used as flakes or powder, so a dried red Capsicum spice record is the appropriate ingredient identity rather than fresh chili, chili sauce, or a generic seasoning mix. The pinned USDA record covers red/cayenne pepper (Capsicum frutescens or Capsicum annuum). Confidence remains medium because gochugaru cultivars, grind size, and heat level differ from cayenne; this decision does not generalize to gochujang, green chili flakes, paprika blends, or chili oil.
